summary: Designed the reference bulb part (A60 with E26 base) according to constraints. The model was created using a robust method of lofting between the base and a spherical envelope. The final dimensions are 110mm in length and 60mm in diameter. Views have been rendered and design notes are complete.

Validation PASSED for bulb. The part's geometry and dimensions accurately reflect the constraints for a reference A60/E26 light bulb. A DFM failure for tool access on an enclosed cavity was noted but deemed acceptable as the part is for reference only and not for manufacturing.
